task.title: Report ignored origin refs in human output for mutations and setup
task.description:
Refs skipped under origin's task namespace are invisible in human output for every command except the explicit fetch, push, and sync.

writeIgnoredRefs (internal/cli/output.go:327-334) is only reached from writeSyncResult, which only runs for `fetch`, `push`, and `sync`. Mutation and setup human output goes through writeSyncReport (internal/cli/output.go:234-243), which prints one line: "Sync:\tcompleted". The refs are present in --json under sync.fetch.ignoredRefs, so this is a human-output gap only.

Reproduce with an origin holding refs/workbook/tasks/EVIL:
  $ workbook create "Local task"
  WB-...\tbacklog\tmedium\tLocal task
  Sync:\tcompleted            # no Ignored: lines
  $ workbook setup --no-docs --no-skill
  ... Sync:\tcompleted        # no Ignored: lines

`setup` is the one bootstrap command a new teammate runs and is the moment they would most want to be told origin's namespace is poisoned; it prints nothing.

Note what is already covered, so this does not get over-scoped. PR #30 left the reporting for skipped *names* where it is. A follow-up commit on that branch (4fa2ba6) made a mutation that fetches a tip it cannot *validate* emit an auto-sync-incomplete warning on stderr naming the count, so the malformed-object case does reach human mutation output. The remaining gap is the ignoredRefs list itself, for mutations and for setup.

Deferred from PR #30 (WB-01KZBT4D40T8493847N5HWMGCH) as a minor review finding: the ticket's acceptance criterion is satisfied by the explicit commands, and reporting is not a correctness gap. Worth closing because the report is now the only signal that anything is wrong with origin's namespace.

Related and deliberately out of scope for PR #30 for the same reason: `sync --watch` and `serve` do not announce ignored refs either, because doing that without repeating the list every tick needs the announce-once bookkeeping recordConflicts has.
